description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller providing utility endpoints such as a welcome message, a redirect to API documentation, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that provides utility endpoints including welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message to the user.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the client to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a string with basic application information.
